shows.title: Investigating Death / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Former Deputy Coroner Donna Francart will discuss the realities of death investigation, what her duties were as a coroner, the cases that defined her career, and how she endured years of grief, trauma, and gore. She'll talk about the spirits who followed her home long after she retired the badge, body bags, toe tags, and her pager. Followed by Open Lines—give George a call and discuss whatever's on your mind!

shows.title: Biology of Belief / UFOs & Cryptids
shows.first_half: Cell biologist and author Bruce Lipton joins Connie Willis (info) to present his view that our thoughts, beliefs, emotions, and the love we experience can shape our biology from moment to moment, rather than DNA alone determining our health and destiny. Followed by researcher Stan Gordon, who examines the growing number of close-range daylight encounters involving UFOs, orbs, Bigfoot, and other cryptids, along with strange activity at Skinwalker Ranch, and reports of out-of-place animals.
shows.second_half: 6-10pm PT: Art Bell - Somewhere in Time returns to August 3, 1998, when Efiong Sam talked about how God is living now on Earth as part of his lost tribe in Nigeria.

shows.title: Reverse Speech / UFO/Alien Experiences
shows.first_half: First Half: Joining Connie Willis (info), Australian author David John Oates will delve into reverse speech, a phenomenon he discovered in 1983 that has been the focus of his continuous research. He views reverse speech as another form of human communication, and will explain how some believe it’s the dead communicating with us.
shows.second_half: Second Half:  Musician and educator Terry Fisher spent years performing throughout New England and Canada before deciding to publicly share his own extraordinary experiences. He'll recount his journey as a UFO experiencer, describe the events that changed his life, and offer his perspective on disclosure.

shows.title: The Manson Murders / Regression Revelations
shows.first_half: First Half: On this date in 1969, Leno and Rosemary LaBianca were murdered in their LA home by members of the Manson Family. True crime researcher Eli Frankel will revisit the Manson murders, separating fact from myth while examining what really happened during those infamous August nights that continue to captivate the public.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Regression therapist Barbara Lamb will discuss her beliefs about what happens to the soul after death, the phenomenon of walk-ins, UFO encounters, and the past lives of ETs. Drawing on thousands of regression sessions, she'll share the patterns and insights she says have emerged from her work.

shows.title: Unseen Influences / Power of Dreams
shows.first_half: First Half: Author, lecturer, and healer Christopher LaPrath will speak about his ability to perceive what he describes as the hidden architecture of reality. He'll explore how past lives, inherited beliefs, and other unseen forces may shape our thoughts and experiences, and share techniques to identify and release those influences.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Bonnie Buckner, PhD, will discuss the transformative power of dreams and why she believes they serve as inner maps that can help us navigate life's challenges and uncover our potential. Drawing on decades of experience, she'll explain how dreams can foster creativity and provide insight.

shows.title: Alien Agenda & AI / Spirit Communication & Magick
shows.first_half: First Half: Author Steve Quayle will discuss what he believes is the alien agenda, what the government knows, and the evidence he says points to information being withheld from the public. He'll also share his views on the rapid evolution of AI and why he believes it is growing beyond humanity's original intentions.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Psychic-medium and "Good Witch" Patti Negri will delve into spirit communication, haunted dolls, séances, and practical magick. She'll explain why she believes spirits may attach themselves to objects, how to recognize signs from the departed, and share techniques for protection and energy clearing.

shows.title: Occult Elvis / Akashic Records Guidance
shows.first_half: First Half: With the anniversary of Elvis Presley's death approaching, writer and podcaster Miguel Conner will explore the life and legacy of the King of Rock and Roll, focusing on his lesser-known interests in mysticism and the occult. He'll also examine the circumstances surrounding Elvis's death and reports of alleged sightings and apparitions in the years since.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Akashic Records teacher Amy Robeson will discuss how the Akashic Records can serve as a practical spiritual resource for everyday life, offering guidance on relationships, life decisions, emotional healing, and the deeper lessons shaping a person's journey.

shows.title: Angels & Prayer / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Radleigh Valentine, an author and teacher whose work has inspired millions to deepen their connection with God, angels, and prayer, joins guest host, Rich Berra (email). Creator of numerous oracle and tarot decks, Valentine is known for his practical and accessible approach to spirituality. He'll discuss how angels may communicate through signs, intuition, synchronicities, and everyday experiences, and explain why he believes prayer is one of the most powerful tools for guidance, healing, and transformation. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half. Give Rich a call and talk about whatever is on your mind!
